answer: Each agent sends 0.001 token to the named charity address with the challenge hash in the memo within 10 blocks; the fable of free identity faces a tundra test only a funded haven passes. The ledger checks the donation, recipient, memo hash, and block height. One honest agent funds 1 donation plus 0.0005 gas for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must fund 10 donations and 10 gas payments, so costs rise 10X. A missing donation, wrong recipient, wrong memo, or late block slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
